The agent downloaded f1040sc--2024.pdf (step 11) but never extracted it; its hard-coded line list in build_deliverables.py labels 24a 'Car and truck expenses' and 24b 'Travel and meals', so $7,534.42 travel landed on 24b instead of the form's 24a (Travel).

EX-016 notes the CHK-1401 (01/10) vs AP10758 PaidDate (02/09) mismatch but only says 'Tie AP paid date to bank clearing date; investigate cutoff', with no analysis of plausible causes.

The log has 19 rows covering 7 of 8 expected issues, but logs payroll as $51,000 bank-only instead of the $45,138.61 GL gap, leaves EX-001 Amount blank, and uses Status 'Open'/'Proposed AJE' (no Resolved/Unresolved; that vocabulary is not in the prompt, but the payroll miss is the root).

Part I Line 7 never equals $36,173.98 (the GL column omits $37.56 interest; the tax-ready column also deducts the $1,847.50 CHK-1402 AJE) and Part II puts $0 on Line 15 Insurance by booking the premium to prepaid; the wrong 24a/27a labels (unread form, R) also contributed.
